Quick one to close out the Aster entry for Q2 forecasting. We still have three open lines where Amount, Product/SKU mapping, and Next Step are missing or set to very low probability. To get ARR into the model for this week’s rollup I need the following by EOD Tuesday: 

- Confirm dollar Amount (net ARR) for each active line item
- Map each line to a SKU from the attached template (pipeline_cleanup_template.csv)
- Confirm Next Step (e.g., PO, Legal review, Onsite demo) and an expected close date

Ben — please push this to the AE owners (copy their names into the sheet) and flag any gating items. Kara — if procurement has a PO draft, please attach it and we’ll reconcile amounts.

If helpful I can jump on a 15 min sync Tue morning; otherwise filling the CSV is ideal.
